entries.0a39a845c307795f: This business handles image processing software and technologies and products related to renewable energy and nuclear power, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥209 million. It consists of the GEO Solutions Field, the Energy Field and the Nuclear-Related Field.
entries.2af3f9fb7186c4f9: Headquartered in Osaki, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo, it operates 2 businesses: the Healthcare Solutions Business and the Global Environment Solutions Business. There is also an equity-method affiliate, Sou Innovation Co., Ltd. (holding 30.9% of voting rights), which conducts joint development of tritium separation technology and other activities. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was 42. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.89dbfff0c1942dcd: Operators in construction, civil engineering and surveying
entries.97e966ac72717fec: This field sells products that use advanced technologies such as the spread of tritium separation technology, radiation-resistant cameras, and continuous tritium measuring instruments. Tritium separation technology is being researched jointly with Sou Innovation Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, and the Ohmura Laboratory, Faculty of Science and Technology, Keio University. Revenue by field is not separately disclosed.
entries.9aaf05dc84c64ace: This business sells medical information systems and medical consumables, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥657 million. It consists of the Medical Systems Field and the Medical Supply Field.
entries.b4062c81c75b2132: A company that sells medical information systems such as medical imaging systems, medical consumables, three-dimensional image processing software, and nuclear-related technologies.
entries.e2587185dc81e7d5: This field develops and sells PACS (medical image storage, distribution and display system), network systems for medical images within hospitals, radiology department information systems, cloud-based ordering electronic medical records, nuclear medicine dose management systems and others. It also provides remote image diagnosis support services and sells an integrated viewer, a medical document scanning system, the medical management system 'ONE Viewer' and the payment agency service 'ONE Payment'. Revenue by field is not separately disclosed.
entries.f2d0593ebabf921e: Counterparties for the trading of solar power plants and similar assets
entries.f8a686a001342a7c: While monitoring trends in the renewable energy market, this field engages in trading activities for solar power plants and similar assets in the secondary market. Revenue by field is not separately disclosed.
